title: Advisers Chinese commitment gold item
description: One JSONL line of the Chinese commitment gold corpus. IMPORTANT: commitments.zh.gold.seed.jsonl is AI-prelabeled draft data (pending_human_review=true), not a human gold set. Human review is required before pending_human_review becomes false or any metric is claimed as reached.

id.description: Globally unique stable id, e.g. gold-001.

date.description: Message / meeting / contract timestamp with timezone. Relative dates in the text are resolved against this value (Asia/Shanghai).

text.description: Redacted message text. Every expect[].quote must be a verbatim substring of this string.

expect.description: Expected commitment candidates. An empty array is valid and useful (negative/non-commitment examples for precision).

provenance.description: synthetic = fully made up; anonymized = real message after documented redaction. Raw private messages must never be committed.

pending_human_review.description: true for AI-prelabeled draft entries. Only a completed dual-human review may set this to false.

action.description: Short verb phrase (<= 12 Chinese chars recommended), e.g. 发报价.

debtor.description: Who owes the promise: user = the person whose messages these are; third = the counterparty; unknown = unclear.

creditor.description: Who receives the promise; null when unknown.

due.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null when no deadline is stated.

dueAlt.description: Optional second acceptable due date, only when there is a documented ambiguity (weekend/holiday shift, inclusive/exclusive boundary). The runner accepts either due or dueAlt.

quote.description: Verbatim substring of item.text; never normalized, never paraphrased.
